summary: A static audit with no vectors downloaded. It found several [R] items well: SVC vs LDA, missing artifacts, missing evaluation code, the cell 307 and cell 274 slips, bad glosses, noun-list noise and the missing licence. It caught the Shift/Hybrid p-value oddity and the FR mismatch only as symptoms, and missed the p-value mechanism, circularity, masculine-only cues, b_w, and the 200k vs 50k candidate set. It also endorsed T2 as detecting the shift correction and took p=0.269 as support for the qualitative claim, which cost two endorsement penalties. Process is well documented, with checkable cell references and saved scripts.
